data.notes: October 2026 is anchored by TAG DER CLUBKULTUR’s citywide club-culture week, with strong techno/house programming at Berghain/RSO plus diaspora-focused Afro, Latin and amapiano events.

events.title: TAG DER CLUBKULTUR 2026: STAY CORE
events.summary: The 2026 edition runs under the theme “STAY CORE,” presenting around 130 events across Berlin clubs, collectives and cultural spaces. The program includes club nights, concerts, open airs, performances, workshops, panels and radio takeovers.

events.title: Sound Metaphors Festival
events.venueName: Berghain / Panorama Bar / Säule / Kantine am Berghain
events.summary: Sound Metaphors Festival is confirmed as a three-day program from October 28–30 across Berghain’s spaces. The lineup includes Alessandro Cortini, Grand River, Jonathan Fitoussi and ASIA on Part 1, with the wider program spanning live electronics, dub, ambient, techno and leftfield club music.

events.title: Innervisions
events.summary: Innervisions marks two decades with a Panorama Bar label night. The confirmed lineup features Âme live, Âme DJ, JAMIIE, Jimi Jules, Julya Karma and Trikk.

events.title: BCCO Halloween
events.summary: BCCO makes its RSO debut with a 32-hour non-stop Halloween Klubnacht featuring future.666, AEREA live, Mac Declos, Matrixxman, Bailey Ibbs, DJ Hyperdrive, Luigi Madonna, ASEC live and more.

events.title: Klubnacht
events.summary: A core Berghain / Panorama Bar Klubnacht, with the official programme highlighting Joris Biesmans' live Panorama Bar performance bridging analogue 80s arpeggios and contemporary club music.

events.title: Climate 24 hours: Peach, DJ Travella live, livwutang
events.summary: RA Pick Climate Of Fear stages a 24-hour Spandau excursion with Peach, DJ Travella live, upsammy, Lechuga Zafiro, Gabrielle Kwarteng, Kikelomo b2b Kontronatura and livwutang.

events.title: VERKNIPT Germany - Berlin - October 9
events.summary: Dutch hard-techno powerhouse VERKNIPT lands at OST with ANDATA, Charleen Herzig, Johannes Schuster, Niotech, O.B.I. b2b Tassery, SAIKA, SUSKA, TRIPTYKH and WAN.

events.title: Amelie Lens with AKUA
events.summary: Belgian techno DJ and producer Amelie Lens brings her live show to Uber Eats Music Hall. The confirmed support is AKUA.

events.title: Tyla - A*POP Tour
events.summary: Tyla performs at Uber Eats Music Hall on her “A*POP” tour. Royal MusiQ and Bloody Civilian are listed as support.

events.title: CUTE /w 1luu, MRGNSTRN, KLING&KLANG, DJ Henk
events.summary: DUALISMBERLIN's CUTE returns to Lokschuppen for a high-attendance night of contemporary club music, euphoric trance, bounce and hard-dance leaning techno.

events.title: LITTLEBIG
events.summary: RA Pick LITTLEBIG returns to Zenner for its annual alternative electronic celebration with KiNK live, JakoJako live, Skee Mask, Randomer, Plaid DJ, David August DJ, Cecilia Tosh and Sarah Sommers live.

events.title: XTRUDE x EUPHORIA SESSIONS
events.summary: RSO’s XTRUDE series teams with Elli Acula’s EUPHORIA SESSIONS for a weekend club night. Confirmed artists include Chris Liebing, Truncate, Phil Berg live, Elli Acula, Angel D’lite b2b IAMBP, Andy Garvey and Clarisa Kimskii.

events.title: Khalid - It’s Always Summer Somewhere Tour
events.summary: Khalid performs at Uber Eats Music Hall as part of his “It’s Always Summer Somewhere” tour. The venue describes his sound as a blend of R&B, pop and soul.

events.title: XTRUDE x EUPHORIA SESSIONS w/ Chris Liebing, Truncate, Phil Berg live, Elli Acula, Angel D'lite
events.summary: RSO's ROBUS and SUMME rooms host a long-form techno/breakbeat session led by Chris Liebing, Elli Acula, Truncate, Phil Berg live, Andy Garvey, Angel D'lite b2b IAMBP and others.

events.title: TOGETHER FOREVER: Weekender + Free Saturday Open Air with SENSUS & Fäncy
events.summary: Kater’s October weekender runs from Friday night to Sunday morning with a free Saturday open air. The lineup includes DJ Fett Burger, Esther Silex, Jakob Mäder, nd_baumecker, M.ono b2b Eva Rose, Kurilo and Pascale Project.

events.title: HEISSS I 30 hours
events.summary: HEISSS brings a 30-hour RSO session across ROBUS and SUMME with Amphia x Cryptofauna, Disguised on a seven-hour closing set, Ignez, Kaiser, Kim She, Toobris, Red Rooms and more.

events.title: ...GET PERLONIZED
events.summary: Perlon’s Berlin label night returns to ZENNER with Mathew Jonson live, The Mole, Sammy Dee and Zip. The event is listed for house and minimal sounds.

events.title: Marteria - Zum Glück in die Zukunft Tour 2026
events.summary: German rapper Marteria plays Max-Schmeling-Halle on his “Zum Glück in die Zukunft Tour 2026.” FAYAN is listed as support.

events.title: Jazzfest Berlin 2026
events.venueName: Haus der Berliner Festspiele and other venues
events.summary: Jazzfest Berlin’s 2026 edition is confirmed for October 29 to November 1 at Haus der Berliner Festspiele and other venues. The full 2026 programme was not yet published on the source page at research time.

events.title: J. Cole – The Fall-Off Tour
events.summary: J. Cole is confirmed at Uber Arena on October 7, 2026 as part of his The Fall-Off Tour. The venue page lists an 20:00 start and tickets on sale.

events.title: Niall Horan – Dinner Party Live On Tour
events.summary: Niall Horan is confirmed for Uber Arena on October 8, 2026 with the Dinner Party Live On Tour. The official venue page lists a 20:00 start and tickets available.

events.title: The Strokes – Reality Awaits Tour
events.summary: The Strokes are confirmed at Uber Arena on October 15, 2026 on the Reality Awaits tour. The official venue page names Alex Cameron as opener and Fat White Family as special guest.

events.title: Jill Scott – To Whom This May Concern 2026 Tour
events.summary: Jill Scott is confirmed at Tempodrom on October 6, 2026 on the To Whom This May Concern 2026 Tour. The venue describes it as her only Germany concert on the run and her first German show in more than 10 years.

events.title: Anastacia – #NTK26 Tour
events.summary: Anastacia is confirmed at Tempodrom on October 16, 2026 for the #NTK26 Tour. The show celebrates 25 years of Not That Kind with a 20:00 start in the Große Arena.

events.title: FOREVER 25 curated by Mila Stern & Esther Silex
events.summary: Kater’s Forever 25 weekender runs for 50+ hours with house and tech-house sounds, curated by Mila Stern and Esther Silex as part of the club’s anniversary-season programming.

events.title: Open2Close: Juliana Huxtable all night long
events.summary: RSO.BERLIN lists Juliana Huxtable for an Open2Close all-night set on October 23, 2026. Resident Advisor lists the event as a techno night in ROBUS from 23:00 to 08:00.

events.title: Four Play
events.summary: Long-running KitKat/Section 8 sex-positive residency spanning techno, house, disco, psytrance, performance and consent-led play spaces across multiple floors.

events.title: ARENA RAVE
events.summary: A large-format hard techno/trance rave brand landing in Berlin with a heavy, dark, high-capacity production concept rather than an arena-headliner concert format.

events.title: Four Play at KitKatClub
events.summary: Four Play is confirmed at KitKatClub on October 2, 2026. Resident Advisor lists a multi-floor programme covering techno, house, disco, psytrance, jazz, blues, funk and cabaret, with Section 8 Berlin involved in concept and execution.

events.title: The Fray – Autumn Light Tour
events.summary: The Fray are confirmed at Tempodrom on October 28, 2026 on the Autumn Light Tour. The venue page lists the show in the Große Arena with doors at 18:30 and a 20:00 start.

events.title: Slave To The Rave Halloween
events.summary: Quest Agency’s Slave To The Rave Halloween edition at OST pairs BAUGRUPPE90, DJ Hell and Huamaniser with a no-photo, anti-discrimination techno-rave ethos.

events.title: Kaizers Orchestra – Tour 2026
events.summary: Kaizers Orchestra are confirmed at Huxleys Neue Welt on October 9, 2026. The Eventim/Berlin.de listing describes the date as part of the Norwegian band’s October 2026 European comeback tour.

events.title: DJ Seinfeld
events.summary: A Berlin stop for DJ Seinfeld, a key modern house/lo-fi house artist, billed around warm, emotional club music and electro-leaning dancefloor textures.

events.title: 5 Years Of Gabber Industries Berlin
events.summary: Gabber Industries Berlin marks its fifth anniversary with a techno/gabber night, a niche but notable hardcore-adjacent scene milestone.

events.title: ODD pres Paracek
events.summary: OST’s OneDayDream volume 3 returns with Paraçek, Charleen Herzig, Danilo Filipe and NIKKI030 on a techno-focused local promoter bill.

events.title: Devoted w. A.N.I., Kø:lab, SaltySis, KLING&KLANG
events.summary: Devoted’s OST edition brings a multi-artist techno lineup with A.N.I., Kø:lab, SaltySis, KLING&KLANG, Nettta and SEKTOR69, fitting the city’s local hard/peak-time circuit.

events.title: Kinktastisch! Techno. Kink. Play
events.summary: Kink-positive techno and tech-house party at Insomnia with DJs Scary, Anne Decks and Francee, a midnight show, dungeon spaces and an explicit consent/awareness framework.
